title: EchoStar Gains on SpaceX Talks; Lumentum, Marvell Reach Deal | Stock Movers
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- EchoStar (ECHO) is gaining on news Elon Musk's SpaceX is looking to start a wireless service with Echostar.
- Lumentum (LITE) is moving on news Marvell Technology has reached a deal to buy Lumentum at an enterprise value of $115 billion. Lumentum makes lasers and other optical technology for moving enormous amounts of data at high speeds, which underpins the AI boom.
- Apple (AAPL) shares are moving ahead of its earnings report today. Apple shares have climbed 25% from a low in late June, adding roughly $1 trillion in market value, as the company’s steady revenue growth and rising free cash flow have offered a haven for investors. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Natural Gas Rises on Lower Appalachian Output, Cooler Weather
summary: US natural gas futures increased as production dropped over the weekend, led by declines in the shale fields of Appalachia. The dip in supply signals producers may be curtailing output because of low prices. Forecasts also shifted slightly cooler, indicating higher demand for the furnace and power-plant fuel as the winter heating season gets underway.

title: A Fundamental Problem With the Economy
